items.question: What ritual sequence should a practitioner follow after invoking the tīrtha?
items.inference: The verse prescribes invoking the tīrtha first, then drawing the maṇḍala in the prior manner.
uncertainties: Exact referent of pūrvavan is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: First invoke the tīrtha, then draw the maṇḍala as before.
